name: skills-registry-frankie
description: A curated, metadata-only registry of open-source GitHub Agent Skills.

scripts.check: npm run check:files && npm run check:json && npm run check:registry
scripts.check:files: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const expected=['README.md','agents.json','package.json','skill_maps.md','skills.json'];const actual=fs.readdirSync('.').filter((name)=>!['.git','node_modules'].includes(name)).sort();if(JSON.stringify(actual)!==JSON.stringify(expected))throw new Error('Expected exactly: '+expected.join(', ')+'; found: '+actual.join(', '));console.log('File set OK');"
scripts.check:registry: node -e "const registry=require('./skills.json');const config=require('./agents.json');if(registry.schemaVersion!==1||!Array.isArray(registry.skills)||registry.skills.length===0)throw new Error('Invalid skills registry');const ids=new Set();for(const skill of registry.skills){for(const key of ['id','name','repository','path','version','license','install'])if(!skill[key])throw new Error(skill.id+' is missing '+key);if(ids.has(skill.id))throw new Error('Duplicate skill id: '+skill.id);ids.add(skill.id);if(!skill.repository.startsWith('https://github.com/'))throw new Error(skill.id+' is not hosted on GitHub');if(skill.install.scope!=='project'||skill.install.command.includes('--global')||skill.install.command.split(' ').includes('-g'))throw new Error(skill.id+' is not repo-only');if(!skill.install.command.startsWith('npx skills add ')||!skill.install.command.includes('--skill '+skill.name))throw new Error(skill.id+' has an invalid install command');}for(const id of [...config.presets.required,...config.presets.all])if(!config.agents[id])throw new Error('Unknown agent: '+id);if(config.scope!=='project'||config.installPolicy.allowGlobal!==false)throw new Error('Agent policy must be repo-only');console.log('Registry OK');"
